method.error: SEM of block means; propagated alloy and pure-component variances. Diagnostic, not a 95% confidence interval.
method.assumptions: Independent composition runs and approximately independent 5 ps blocks; systematic potential and finite-size errors excluded.
method.segment_test: Welch-Satterthwaite approximation for disjoint old/new segments; BH adjustment across nine compositions. Correlations between segments, if present, are not estimated.
method.restart: Exact atomic state preserved; thermostat/barostat internal variables reset. All new steps retained in primary estimate.
